result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice ('We believe', 'We work to') with community and sustainability framing leading. Much of the page is a heritage timeline and headline statistics, which are business description. Governance and workforce appear only briefly. Commitments are stated absolutely rather than hedged.
